description: Compute realized variance in log-odds space
steps: Support rolling window calculation with configurable lookback
Handle NaN values in dx series (skip or propagate)
Calculate: sqrt(RV / T) where T = n * dt_years
Create WindowConfig class with window_name, periods, dt_years
Return volatility in annualized log-odds units

description: Compute Median Absolute Deviation for robust scale
steps: Apply scaling: sigma_mad = 1.4826 * MAD (to match std for normal)
Handle edge cases: too few observations, all zeros
Return both raw MAD and scaled sigma_mad

description: Compute Truncated Realized Variance for belief volatility
steps: Compute threshold: theta = c * sigma_mad (c in [5, 10])
Track count of included vs excluded increments

description: Compute Bipower Variation for jump-robust volatility
steps: Use mu_1 = sqrt(2/pi) constant for scaling if needed
Handle short series (need at least 2 observations)
Map window names to periods: 1h=120 (30s bins), 1d=2880, 7d=20160
For each window, compute: RV, TRV, BV, sigma_realized, sigma_b_trv, sigma_b_bv
Return nested dict keyed by window name
Handle case where series is shorter than window (use full series)

description: Create summary statistics for volatility metrics
steps: Fields: window, realized_variance, realized_vol_ann, belief_vol_trv, belief_vol_bipower
